name: 01-room
notes: The browser room's own replay golden, as a script the Godot host can be driven by. Transcribed from SCRIPT in web/lib/pointclick/replay.test.ts, which is the fixture room solved with misses on the way — the misses are in the script on purpose, because `interaction/refused` is an occurrence a consumer draws and a golden that only walked the happy path would never hash one. There is no seed and no step: a room has no clock, so a replay is a list of clicks rather than a number of frames. `.web.jsonl` is the state and the events after every click and `.web-frames.txt` one unchained digest per click, which is the same pair the two side-view genres carry.
